description: Overcome fear of storms in one peaceful Zoom session. No trance, no exposure, no long-term therapy.
heroTag: Stop letting a fear of storms rule your forecast
heroH1: Hear the thunder. Calm and settled. Finally.
heroP: One peaceful Zoom session. No trance. No reliving trauma. No long-term therapy — a calmer, freer you on your terms.
problemH2: Don’t let a fear of storms rule your forecast
problemP: Forecast-checking, canceled plans, hours of dread for storms that may never come. The villain is not you. It is a misfiring subconscious program — once meant to protect you, now firing indiscriminately.
quote: You are someone who hears thunder and stays settled. That person already exists inside you.
externalH3: The sky, the radar, the rumble
externalP: Sky darkens and you hide in the radar loop.
internalP: Safe indoors — and still panicking. Canceling plans on a cloudy day.
deeperH3: A world fenced by one fear
deeperP: Events missed. Sleep lost. Days ruled by weather apps.
reliefP: By the end of your session you will feel your world shift. Hear the thunder. Stay present. Feel calm.
cost1P: The gathering you keep canceling when clouds gather.
cost2P: Each storm avoided in life still lives in your body.
cost3P: If refreshing the radar hasn’t fixed it, it won’t next storm either.
ctaH2: Your next calm night is one session away
